title: ARC mutex holder record
description: mutex/<ENCODED-CLASS>/holder.json - who holds one global mutex class. Written by the acquiring worker (claim-protocol section 3), by /arc-publish-plan as __PUBLISH__ (publish-protocol) or by the owner as __OWNER__ (owner-ops section 6). The owner of a held class is the pair (arcId ?? null, taskId): a legacy holder carries no arcId; a holder taken for an ARC task, or by a reserved id acting for an ARC, carries arcId equal to that ARC. Release is legal only on an exact pair match (K14, D-28). Mutex classes stay global - the directory name is the class alone, never namespaced by ARC; the holder's arcId disambiguates the holder, never the class. Shape only (B4, P-E0): ownership is decided by scripts/lib/runtime-identity.js holderOwnershipMatches.

taskId.description: The holding task id, or one of the reserved holder ids __PUBLISH__ / __OWNER__ (publish validation rejects any task id beginning with __, so the two can never collide with a real task).

lane.description: Lane of the holding worker; OWNER for the reserved holders.

arcId.description: OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). Present only when the holder acts for an ARC (an arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/ task, or __PUBLISH__ / __OWNER__ acting for that ARC) and then equal to that ARC; absent for every legacy-stream holder. Never null.

taskId.description: Uppercase, filesystem-safe, must start and end alphanumeric; the reserved Windows device names are excluded (same rule as plan.schema.json).

reservedHolderId.description: The two reserved holder ids (runtime-contract section 3).

arcId.description: OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). ARC identity. Absent in every legacy record; present in every ARC-scoped record and equal to the ARC it belongs to - the publisher's ARC literal for a snapshot, its manifest and plans/arcs/<ARC-ID>/current.json (three-way equality), the arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/ directory for claims, tokens and the holders taken for that ARC. Never inferred from a task-id prefix, a filename or a slug. The reserved Windows device-name guard applies uniformly (N-3). The schema validates shape only; namespace rules live in scripts/lib/runtime-identity.js.
